landing.title: Build your shinobi. Master the deck.
landing.lead: Kage Legacy is a solo deck-building roguelike: create your character, craft a 20–30 card deck, unlock talents, and clear combat missions.

features.character: Create your shinobi — element, clan, and talent points from level one.
features.deck: A starter collection and deck so you can fight immediately, then refine your build.
features.talents: A deep talent tree: every level grants a point, never free stats.
features.missions: PvE mission runs with combat, rewards, shop boosters and a seasonal Battle Pass.
